summary: ci-local reads /proc once when a stopped run stops its lane, instead of once per process of the lane's tree with a sed per process on the host, so a stopped run on a loaded host exits in well under a second instead of waiting over 20 s

replay.detail: A local CI script change only; no replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
